levels.surface: عبد الله بـنالحسين بن زيد بن علي بن الحسين بن علي بن أبي طالب

notes: «حدثنا أبي» opens the chain with the compiler's father, a bare relation (rule 7). «10-22» is a number, left out.
The Imam «عن علي» inside the chain stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); the Prophet's words that follow are not a link.
The source writes «عبد الله بـنالحسين» without a space; the surface is copied as written.
